---
title: German Law
---

German drone regulations are governed by the Luftverkehrs-Ordnung (LuftVO) and the Luftfahrtgesetz (LuftG). Key points include:

- Drones under 2 kg can be flown without a license, but must be registered with the Luftfahrt-Bundesamt (LBA).
- Drones over 2 kg require a license and must be registered with the LBA.
